**What's New in Version 2.4**

Version 2.4 makes the app faster, more stable and usable in more places. Here's what's changed.

**Offline Mode**
You can now use the app without an internet connection. Whether you're on a flight, in a subway tunnel or somewhere with weak signal, you can keep going without waiting for a connection. When you're back online, the app picks up where you left off.

**Faster Startup**
We've reworked how the app launches. Startup time has dropped from 3.4 seconds to 1.9 seconds, so you spend about 44% less time waiting each time you open it.

**Stability Improvements**
This release fixes 12 crashes. You should see fewer unexpected shutdowns and smoother sessions overall. Thank you to everyone who sent crash reports. They helped us find and fix these problems.

**Platform Support Changes**
Version 2.4 no longer supports Android 8. To install this update and future releases, your device needs Android 9 or later. If you're not sure which version you have, open your device's Settings and look under "About phone."

Thanks for using the app. We hope you enjoy this update!
